source: Planted for wf-intake on bench/brief's greet-cli seed: the request asks for something only visible after merge.

request.text: Support folks asked for a louder greeting for the lobby screen. Can we get a --shout option on greet, and make sure it shows up on the published docs site so they can point people at it?

trap: .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ only on a push to main, so the published page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ cannot show --shout while the pull request is open.
must_catch: The docs ask becomes a line checkable at the head, such as docs/index.md documenting --shout, with the published page left to the outcome or non_goals.
An expect line says the output without --shout is unchanged, so the default greeting is protected.
must_not: An expect line that can only be checked on the published page or after merge.
